text:
maya: Quick ping — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4218 that adjusts KV prewarm heuristics and adds a small change to attention kernel selection. Need a quick review+approve if possible, aiming to merge before tomorrow's canary window (09:00 PDT). @kevin @olga
kevin: Can do a pass in ~30m.
olga: Skimmed the diff, left 2 inline comments. Main concern: non-atomic increment in shard prewarm path might race when multiple prewarm workers run.
olga: Code snippet from the PR I commented on:
```go
// non-atomic update
cache.shards[i].count++
// should be: atomic.AddInt64(&cache.shards[i].count, 1)
```
maya: Good catch, thanks. I'll push a tiny fix to make the increment atomic and add a unit test for concurrent prewarm.
deploy-bot: CI triggered for PR #4218 — https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/12345 (unit tests + perf-smoke).
maya: Pushed fix (commit 3f2b9a7) that switches to atomic and adds a test.
deploy-bot: CI passed — unit: 312/312, integration: 14/14. Perf-smoke: long-tail latency +0.3% on 8k sequences (within tolerance). Full logs: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/12345/logs.
ryan: Can we also add a short test that simulates two prewarm workers hitting the same shard? I can add that if you want.
maya: That would be great if you have cycles, thanks. I focused on the microtest; a small concurrency sim would increase confidence.
olga: Re-reviewed after commit, comments addressed. Approving :thumbsup:
kevin: LGTM as well. Approving — will hold merge until the morning canary window unless we need emergency deploy.
maya: I'm going to merge now and kick a canary target that runs the rollout to 5% for 1 hour, then 25% for 30m if healthy. I'll monitor traces and latency dashboards.
deploy-bot: PR #4218 merged by maya at 1765439248. Release: canary-2026-03-17-1 deployed to cluster-canary-a.
maya: Thanks all — watching metrics. Will post an update if anything spikes. :rocket:
kevin: Thanks — nice quick turnaround.
